title: MOTION (SOTO-MARTINEZ for RAMAN - NAZARIAN) relative to funding for repairs to the landscaping, civil, and structural elements of the Wilcox Triangle and…
text:
[Council File 26-1602; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (SOTO-MARTINEZ for RAMAN - NAZARIAN) relative to funding for repairs to the landscaping, civil, and structural elements of the Wilcox Triangle and vertical lighted Hollywood welcome sign in Council District 4.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the General Services Department (GSD) the use of $153,127 available to Council District 4 from the Hollywood Redevelopment Project Area Special Fund No. 58G (Ordinance No. 184131), for the purpose of funding repairs to the landscaping, civil, and structural elements of the Wilcox Triangle and vertical lighted Hollywood welcome sign.
2. AUTHORIZE the Controller to:
a. Establish a new appropriation account within Hollywood Redevelopment Project Area Fund, Fund No. 58G, Dept 21, Account No. 21El40 and appropriate therefrom $153,127.
b. Transfer $153,127 from the Hollywood Redevelopment Project Area Fund, Fund No. 58G, Dept 21, to General Services Department, Fund No. 100, Dept 40.
c. Appropriate the following within the General Services Department, Fund No. 100, Dept 40 to GSD Construction Forces for the "Wilcox Triangle and Franklin/Cahuenga Capital Improvements," project for the performance of services set forth above, as noted in the Motion, attached to the Council file.
3. AUTHORIZE the Department of General Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers, with the concurrence of the Office of the City Administrative Officer.
